find_books_by_author.description: List the books a given author wrote. Gutendex's own search matches titles as well as author names, so this action checks each result's credited authors, editors and translators and keeps only the real matches: searching 'Dickens' returns his novels, not books with Dickens in the title.

find_books_by_topic.description: List the books filed under a topic: the phrase is matched against Project Gutenberg's bookshelves and subject headings. Alongside the books it returns the exact shelf and subject names that matched, which is the quickest way to find the precise wording to narrow a follow-up search with. A very broad topic can take Gutendex up to a minute to answer.

search_books.description: Search Project Gutenberg's catalogue of free ebooks. Every filter is optional and they combine: search words are matched against author names and book titles, and the rest narrow by topic, language, copyright status, when the author was alive, and which file formats the book is available in. Results are 32 books per page.

description: Search Project Gutenberg's 79,000 free ebooks through Gutendex, a keyless public API. Find books by title, author, topic, language or copyright status, list the most downloaded titles, get download links for every format, and pull a book's full text into a workflow. No account or API key is required.
